publications.name: Uncertainty-Driven 3D Gaussian Splatting for Robust Real-Time RGB-D SLAM
publications.publisher: IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering
publications.summary: First author. Proposes an uncertainty-driven approach for robust real-time SLAM using 3D Gaussian Splatting. Currently under review.

publications.name: TAMBRIDGE: Bridging Frame-Centered Tracking and 3D Gaussian Splatting for Enhanced SLAM
publications.summary: First author. Introduces a novel framework bridging frame-centered tracking with 3D Gaussian Splatting for enhanced SLAM performance. Has 5 citations and is to be submitted to RAL.

publications.name: A Unified End-To-End Network for Category-Level & Instance-Level Object Pose Estimation from RGB Images
publications.publisher: 2025 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2025)
publications.summary: Co-author. Presents a unified end-to-end network for both category-level and instance-level object pose estimation from RGB images.

publications.summary: Co-author. Proposes a debiased multiplex tokenizer approach for efficient map-free visual relocalization. Accepted for presentation.

projects.name: Gaussian Memory Fields as Actionable World Models for Embodied Robotics

highlights: Active Semantic Mapping for Onboard Simulation
Real-time Deployment via Robust State Estimation
